## Reviewer Checklist

- [ ] Jira story and acceptance criteria match the implementation.
- [ ] Handwritten README content is preserved.
- [ ] Tests and documentation drift checks pass.
- [ ] Inputs, path handling, escaping, and secret handling were reviewed.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or corporate content are included.
- [ ] Remaining limitations and skipped checks are accepted.
- [ ] A maintainer has reviewed the diff before merging.
